decisions.reason: The glass flake system extends core two-component spraying know-how into a growing corrosion-protection niche, and without a clear shortfall against aspirations the firm's slack lets it carry the product while results mature.

The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established construction-repair offer, has its own web page and ties up few extra resources, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.

The multi-model transfer pump line builds on core conveying competence and in-house manufacturing, so dropping it only two years after launch would be premature while performance likely matches aspirations.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core offer, so it has not yet had time to fall short of aspirations and warrants continued support.
